issues.description: Attribute GroverKakuro.number_of_qubits_query_register has a type mismatch between template and solution. In template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py the attribute is initialized as a float literal (self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 0.0). In solution_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py the same attribute is an integer (self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 4). The float value from the template will be passed to QuantumRegister(), which expects an integer and will raise a TypeError / prevent circuit construction, blocking students from running the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template (ex5_grover_kakuro.py) initialize number_of_qubits_query_register as an integer. For consistency with the solution and the exercise description, set: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 4. Also ensure all numeric counts for registers and classical bits in the template are integers (e.g. self.number_of_qubits_auxiliary_register = 1 and self.number_of_bits_classical_register = 4) so they can be passed directly to QuantumRegister and ClassicalRegister without type errors.
